body:
## Adopted from the selected baseline, 4 October 2026

Adopt v0.8: each drawn Shai-Hulud adds a marker; Fremen Thumpers do not. At four markers the Shield Wall counts for victory only. Do not import an older Nexus or storm-rotation trigger.

Norbert selected Quickstart v0.8 as the correct starting point. This question arose from an older version disagreeing with that baseline, not from an unresolved contradiction within v0.8. It no longer needs a separate confirmation. This records the source-precedence decision; it does not claim a new council ruling.

The full drafting pass applies this rule in the relevant chapters. Part of #1831.
title: Dreamrules ruling: Which events add the four Shield Wall markers?
